title: Buying tickets for a musical
instructionsHu: Egy barátoddal Londonban vagy, és ma estére szeretnétek jegyet venni egy musicalre. Beszélj a jegypénztárossal, és intézd el a jegyvásárlást. Minden pontot teljesíts.

situation.context: You are in London with a friend for a few days. You would like to see a musical tonight, so you go to the theatre box office in the afternoon. You can spend about £40 per person.
situation.candidateRole: You are a tourist who wants to buy two tickets.
situation.examinerRole: The examiner is the assistant at the box office.
goals: Ask if there are any tickets left for tonight's show.
Ask about the prices and whether there are cheaper tickets for students.
Choose your seats and say why.
Find out when the show starts and finishes.
situation.examinerOpening: Good afternoon. Welcome to the Riverside Theatre. How can I help?

followUpQuestions: Yes, we still have some seats. They're forty-five pounds downstairs and twenty-eight pounds upstairs in the balcony. Which would you like?
Are you students? If you have a student card, you get ten per cent off.
Here you are. How would you like to pay, by card or in cash?

usefulPhrases.en: Are there any tickets left for tonight?
usefulPhrases.hu: Van még jegy a ma esti előadásra?

usefulPhrases.en: We'd like two seats next to each other.
What time does the show start?
